products.name: Lilac Reverie
products.desc: Two clustered earrings combine sculpted lilac flowers, rounded purple drops and faceted lilac detail. The tonal mix gives a soft colour story with enough shine to hold its own against dark hair.

products.name: Serpentine Psalm
products.desc: A winding serpent silhouette pairs pale turquoise with deep red and is suspended from a faceted red detail. The long curve frames the jaw and gives a simple shirt or dark collar a sharper line.

products.name: Nocturne of the Deep
products.desc: Four silver-tone sculptural pins combine shell, bead-like and organic forms. Wear the set on a lapel, or separate one piece as a quieter mark.

products.name: Coral Reliquary
products.desc: Two gold-tone drop earrings frame coral-tone ovals with turquoise-tone accents and fine sculpted settings. The warm red-orange reads strongly against black and ecru.

products.name: Opaline Arch Cuff
products.desc: A gold-tone bracelet is built from articulated geometric links, with blue-green patterned panels framed by clear detail. Its broad horizontal line gives the wrist presence without competing with rings.

products.name: Two Doves
products.desc: Two silver-tone doves meet around a yellow faceted drop, their wings picked out with dense clear detailing. The open curve sits across the collarbone and gives a dark neckline a single, strong centre.
spec: Clear faceted detail and yellow drop
